    • queryTimeout

      public SqlBeanQueryContext.Builder<T> queryTimeout(Duration value)
      Sets the JDBC query timeout for every statement, rounded up to whole seconds. Default: none.

      Leave unset and this still bounds any statement whose search includes $regex, at a shorter built-in default — set this explicitly to control that bound instead of accepting the default.

      Parameters:
      value - The timeout, or null for none. Must be positive if set.
      Returns:
      This object.
